title: Ultra Pro Pokemon Card Binder 9 Pocket Full-View with Poke Ball Design – Trading Card Binder Holds 360 Cards Side Loading – Organizer for TCG Collectors with Elastic Strap for Sleeved Cards

reviews.title: The greatest binder in the history of Pokemon other than a ...
reviews.body: The greatest binder in the history of Pokemon other than a leather one of course. This can hold 360 cards, prefect to put like 2 full Pokemon sets in there. Our favorite Pokemon youtuber Pokemon Unwrapped uses this same binder to put all his EX, GX , Full Arts & Secret Rares when he gives them away on his channel. There is a strap on this binder to keep the book closed & i have seen up to 3 cards in each holder on both sides & still be ok with no tearing issues. The Pokeball design is so cool & this is one of our favorite binders to use (Pokemom keeps all her EX & GX cards in there each with a Elite trainer card sleeve & no issues).

reviews.title: Side-Loading Binder That Beats the Rest
reviews.body: The Poké Ball cover pops on my shelf and makes the binder easy to spot in a pile of gear.Functionality is dialed in: side-loading pockets hug each Ultra Pro sleeve so tightly that I can flip through pages without a single card sliding out. With room for 360 sleeved cards, the storage feels perfect for a full set while still keeping the binder slim enough to slip into my backpack.The textured cover and neat stitching give it a solid premium feel, yet it stays light, so my shoulder never complains on the walk to game night. An elastic strap keeps everything shut and dust free, and the friendly price means you get real value without any cut corners. Great color, smart design, sturdy build. Ultra Pro is now my go-to.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 2, 2025
reviews.author: Dangioffre

reviews.title: Good for beginners!
reviews.body: I recently got back into Pokemon after almost 9 years and I was in need for a good Pokemon binder. I was worried about flimsy pages and bad protection, but this one is actually good. It came in perfect condition! It comes in a wrapped package, not a box. The only reason there’s a lot of damaged reviews is because of the mailing process. Has nothing to do with the seller thankfully! I plan to eventually upgrade to a hard back since the outside is unfortunately loose plastic, but other than that, it’s really good and I’d totally recommend it for starters or something quick to buy!

reviews.title: My son loves this binder
reviews.body: Prior to buying this binder my son had a pencil box for his pokemon cards, they were always all over the floor in his bedroom, and it drove me nuts.This binder is awesome, and my son spends hours occupied every week reorganizing his pokemon cards. He proudly shows everyone his collection in the binder.It's a pretty sturdy binder, and the cards are secure in the slots.My son is 5 years old, by the way, if this binder can survive him then it can survive pretty much anything, and he can indepently take his pokemon in and out of the secure slots.I'm happy with this purchase.

reviews.title: Great binder for TCG Cards!
reviews.body: I bought this album to store Pokemon cards and they fit perfectly in this album. I like the side-loading pages over the top-loading pages. I did buy a second similar album that is not Pokemon themed for a bit cheaper, but the aesthetics for having a Pokemon Binder for Pokemon Cards is worth the extra $$$

reviews.author: Yoshi

reviews.title: Fantastic binder!
reviews.body: This is a wonderful Pokemon binder. The cards are well protected, you can use sleeves on the cards, and the finished display is gorgeous.  The only possible way it could be better is if you could somehow swap the pages around.The 9 pocket sheets are very strong, but the clear plastic is easy to bend or wrinkle.  This is a tiny nit-pick and not worth deducting a star for.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 24, 2019

features: ORGANIZED CARD STORAGE SYSTEM: Designed with a 9 pocket layout, this binder keeps your collection neatly arranged and easy to browse. The 9 pocket trading card binder format allows quick access, helping you organize and locate cards efficiently without clutter.

LARGE 360 CARD CAPACITY: Holds up to 360 cards when used with sleeves, keeping your collection in one place. This pokemon card binder includes 40 integrated pages, providing structured space for sets, duplicates, or categories as your collection grows.

SECURE SIDE LOADING DESIGN: Side loading pockets help keep cards securely in place during use or transport. This trading card binder reduces the risk of cards slipping out while browsing, protecting valuable cards and keeping them safely stored at all times.

DURABLE BUILD WITH SAFE MATERIALS: Made from archival safe, acid free, non PVC materials for reliable storage. This pokemon binder features an elastic strap closure, embossed center pages for a framed display, and a Poke Ball design cover for a clean themed look.

PROTECT WHAT MATTERS MOST: Since 1952, Ultra Pro has been a trusted name in collectible storage. This trading card binder is designed to help protect and organize your collection with reliable materials and a structure suited for long-term card care.
